description: PostgreSQL preflight reuse — config already exists
input: Analyze our PostgreSQL database for ingestion readiness. The db-analysis-config.json already exists in the working directory. Connection: postgresql://db.example.com/mydb
context: db-analysis-config.json is present in the working directory
assertions: Response does NOT ask the user about schema exclusions, table exclusions, or row limits
Response references db-analysis-config.json as already existing and reuses it
Response proceeds to run the analyzer (mentions source_system_analyzer.py or equivalent next step)
Response does NOT create or overwrite db-analysis-config.json

description: MSSQL preflight — no config, user declines all exclusions
input: Analyze our MSSQL database, no exclusions needed. Connection string is in environment variable MSSQL_URL.
context: No db-analysis-config.json exists in the working directory
assertions: Response asks the user at least one of the three preflight questions (schemas/tables/row-limit exclusions)
Response does NOT create db-analysis-config.json when user says no to all exclusion questions
Response routes to the MSSQL module (references/databases/mssql or MSSQL-specific mention)
Response mentions running the source_system_analyzer.py script or equivalent step

description: Description enrichment continuation after schema.json written
input: The schema.json was just generated but I notice some columns have empty descriptions. Can you fill them in?
assertions: Response mentions running build_description_enrichment_checklist.py
Response describes completing column descriptions BEFORE generating table descriptions (column-first order)
Response mentions querying up to 3 sample rows per unresolved column
Response mentions running apply_description_enrichment.py to merge results back

input: Can you profile this CSV file for ingestion? File: orders_2025.csv
assertions: Response routes to the flat file module (flat/generic or tabular_schema_json.py)
Response does NOT use source_system_analyzer.py for the CSV file
Response mentions tabular_schema_json.py (inspect or to-json subcommand)
Response produces or describes producing a schema.json output

input: Create a dbt model for the orders table based on our source schema.
assertions: Response does NOT run or describe running source-system-analyser scripts
Response redirects to or mentions dbt-model-from-stm skill or equivalent dbt modeling workflow
Response does NOT run any database preflight or schema analysis steps

description: xlsx file routing — must not use database analyzer
input: I have a schema_columns.xlsx file that describes my source schema. Can you analyze it?
assertions: Response routes to the flat file module (flat/generic or tabular_schema_json.py)
Response does NOT use source_system_analyzer.py or treat xlsx as a database source
Response mentions tabular_schema_json.py or the flat/generic workflow

description: Null concept_ids — classification review, not full rerun
input: My schema.json has a lot of null concept_ids and low confidence scores. How do I fix this?
assertions: Response describes the classification review workflow (one family at a time approach)
Response does NOT tell the user to simply rerun source_system_analyzer.py from scratch
Response mentions bucketing or grouping nulls/low-confidence columns before rerunning

description: Vague source — must ask before running
assertions: Response asks the user to specify the source type (database, API, or flat file)
Response does NOT run any scripts or produce a schema.json without more information
Response asks for connection details or file path before proceeding
